name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Resolution on the severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It asks Belarus to release all political prisoners immediately and without conditions. It asks the European Union and its member states to support prisoners and their families, to widen sanctions on those responsible for the repression, and to hold the Lukashenka regime accountable for its crimes.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Political prisoners in Belarus, their families, and Belarusians who fled abroad.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union bodies and member states. They decide whether to act on it.
